Excludes journal envelope and pretty-printing. Checked against each invocation request_sha256 and journal newline-form request_sha256.

request_index.reconstruction: Traverse scripted results.shared_setups then results.cases, each in stored order, and each invocations list in stored order; then historical results.cases and invocations in stored order. Every index row has cohort, reservation_id, repository-relative request_path, request_file_sha256, api_payload_sha256 and api_payload_bytes. Hash canonical JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=true, comma/colon separators, no newline.

measurement_method.statistics: Minimum, mean, median, nearest-rank p90 and maximum describe the finite retained request sample. They are not confidence bounds or expected future costs. Means are rounded to 3 decimal bytes for compact reporting.
